conflicts.title: V2 speed overstated by W1
conflicts.description: W1 estimates the big white SUV at 'Then a big white SUV came from my left along 5th Ave really fast, I would say at least 80 km/h'; V2 telemetry records 57.6 km/h between t=0 s and t=10 s.

details.rule: claimed lower bound - max measured > 15 km/h

conflicts.title: Northbound signal state disputed
conflicts.description: W1 says V1's light was green. The signal controller shows yellow from t=7 s to t=10 s. V1 entered the junction at t≈10 s.

conflicts.title: V1 telemetry dropout during yellow onset
conflicts.description: No V1 records between t=6 s and t=7.5 s, while the northbound signal changed to yellow at t=7 s. V1's reaction to the yellow cannot be confirmed from telemetry.

conflicts.title: W2 claims V1 accelerated; telemetry shows braking
conflicts.description: W2 says the red car 'The light for Main Road had already turned yellow. The red car sped up to beat the light, I am sure of it, it was going fast'. V1 telemetry shows constant then decreasing speed (46.8 km/h at t=0 s, 46.8 km/h at t=9 s, 36 km/h at t=10 s), braking from t=9 s.

conflicts.title: 'Eastbound signal red' has a single source
conflicts.description: 'Eastbound signal red' (t=-20 s–11 s) is supported only by the sensor/controller log. V2's entry on this signal rests on the sensor record alone; no camera or witness saw the signal head.

conflicts.title: 'Northbound signal yellow' has a single source
conflicts.description: 'Northbound signal yellow' (t=7 s–10 s) is supported only by the sensor/controller log. V1's entry on this signal rests on the sensor record alone; no camera or witness saw the signal head.

conflicts.title: V2 vehicle type ambiguous
conflicts.description: W2 is unsure whether V2 was an SUV or a van; W1 say SUV.
